title: Concept: Shard failure detail returned with results
description: A shards block that records a failed shard with its reason in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The reason names the node, the index and often the mapping error, which is both a topology hint and a way to learn the field types.
applicability: Deployments that render a shards block that records a failed shard with its reason into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The reason names the node, the index and often the mapping error, which is both a topology hint and a way to learn the field types.
